model_reviews.source_review_note: CAD_04.md is a 173-slide lecture deck on B-Splines and NURBS (basis functions, divided differences, Cox-de Boor recursion, knot insertion/removal, rational curves and surfaces). The registry attributes to it 'OpenCascade valid-solid/re-import/bounding-box/volume checks' under a 'CAD exchange/solid-modeling background' equation_ref. Grep for opencascade, occ, solid, topolog, b-rep/brep, boundary, STEP, IGES, exchange, bounding, volume, valid, manifold, shell, edge, vertex, euler, kernel, export returned zero relevant hits ('import' matches only unrelated text; 'closed' refers to closed curves; 'tolerance' appears once in a control-point replacement step). The document contains no solid-modeling, topology-validity, data-exchange, re-import, bounding-box or volume-check content, so it cannot support the model. The only tangentially related geometric statement is the convex-hull containment property of B-spline curves (page 40), which is a curve property, not a kernel verification policy.
